298export async function revokePhone(sessionId: string): Promise<string | null> {
299  const session = sessions.get(sessionId);
300  if (!session) return null;
301
302  const prevDevId = session.phoneDeviceId || session.phoneBtAddress;
303  if (prevDevId) {
304    try {
305      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
306      await db.execute(`UPDATE devices SET status = 'ONLINE', "updatedAt" = $1 WHERE id = $2`, [nowIso, prevDevId]);
307    } catch {}
308  }
309
310  session.phoneSocketId = null;
311  session.phoneDeviceName = null;
312  session.phoneBtAddress = null;
313  session.phoneOsType = null;
314  session.phoneIpAddress = null;
315  session.phoneDeviceId = null;
316  session.status = 'WAITING';
317  session.token = generateToken();
318  session.tokenExpiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000);
319  session.updatedAt = new Date();
320  return session.token;
321}
322
323export function setSessionStatus(sessionId: string, status: 'WAITING' | 'PAIRED' | 'CALLING') {
324  const session = sessions.get(sessionId);
325  if (session) {
326    session.status = status;
327    session.updatedAt = new Date();
328  }
329}
330
331export function setPhoneStatus(sessionId: string, phoneStatus: string): void {
332  const session = sessions.get(sessionId);
333  if (session) {
334    session.phoneStatus = phoneStatus;
335    session.updatedAt = new Date();
336  }
337}
338
339export function handleLaptopDisconnect(socketId: string): void {
340  const session = getSessionBySocketId(socketId);
341  if (!session) return;
342
343  session.laptopSocketId = null;
344  session.updatedAt = new Date();
345
346  if (!session.phoneSocketId) {
347    sessions.delete(session.id);
348  }
349}
350
351export async function updateHeartbeat(socketId: string): Promise<Session | undefined> {
352  const session = getSessionBySocketId(socketId);
353  if (session && session.phoneSocketId === socketId) {
354    session.lastHeartbeat = new Date();
355    session.updatedAt = new Date();
356
357    const devId = session.phoneBtAddress || (session.phoneDeviceName ? 'dev_' + session.phoneDeviceName.replace(/\s+/g, '_') : null);
358    if (devId) {
359      try {
360        await db.execute(`UPDATE devices SET "lastSeenAt" = $1, status = 'ONLINE' WHERE id = $2`, [new Date().toISOString(), devId]);
361      } catch {}
362    }
363  }
364  return session;
365}
366
367export async function handlePhoneDisconnect(socketId: string): Promise<Session | undefined> {
368  const session = getSessionBySocketId(socketId);
369  if (!session || session.phoneSocketId !== socketId) return undefined;
370
371  const devId = session.phoneBtAddress || (session.phoneDeviceName ? 'dev_' + session.phoneDeviceName.replace(/\s+/g, '_') : null);
372  if (devId) {
373    try {
374      await db.execute(`UPDATE devices SET status = 'OFFLINE', "lastSeenAt" = $1 WHERE id = $2`, [new Date().toISOString(), devId]);
375    } catch {}
376  }
377
378  // A reconnect may have replaced the socket while the DB update was awaiting.
379  if (session.phoneSocketId !== socketId) return undefined;
380  session.phoneSocketId = null;
381  session.status = 'WAITING';
382  session.lastHeartbeat = null;
383  session.updatedAt = new Date();
384  return session;
385}

387// ─── CANONICAL CALL SESSION ENGINE ───────────────────────────────────────────
388export type CallState =
389  | 'IDLE'
390  | 'COMMAND_SENT'
391  | 'COMMAND_RECEIVED'
392  | 'DIALING'
393  | 'RINGING'
394  | 'ACTIVE'
395  | 'ENDING'
396  | 'ENDED'
397  | 'DIAL_FAILED'
398  | 'PERMISSION_FAILED'
399  | 'REJECTED'
400  | 'BUSY'
401  | 'NO_ANSWER'
402  | 'LOCAL_HANGUP'
403  | 'REMOTE_HANGUP'
404  | 'NETWORK_FAILURE'
405  | 'PHONE_DISCONNECTED'
406  | 'SOCKET_DISCONNECTED'
407  | 'TIMEOUT'
408  | 'RECOVERY_REQUIRED';
409
410export interface CallSession {
411  callId: string;
412  sessionId: string;
413  tenantId: string;
414  userId: string;
415  phoneDeviceId: string;
416  laptopSocketId: string;
417  phoneSocketId: string;
418  leadId?: string;
419  phone: string;
420  name: string;
421  direction: 'OUTBOUND' | 'INCOMING';
422  state: CallState;
423  commandId?: string;
424  campaignId?: string;
425  simSlot?: number | null;
426  createdAt: string;
427  startedAt?: string;
428  activeAt?: string;
429  endedAt?: string;
430  endReason?: string;
431  duration: number;
432}
433
434const activeCallSessions = new Map<string, CallSession>();
435const terminalStates = new Set<CallState>(['ENDED', 'DIAL_FAILED', 'PERMISSION_FAILED', 'REJECTED', 'BUSY', 'NO_ANSWER', 'LOCAL_HANGUP', 'REMOTE_HANGUP', 'NETWORK_FAILURE', 'PHONE_DISCONNECTED', 'SOCKET_DISCONNECTED', 'TIMEOUT']);
436const allowedStates = new Set<CallState>(['IDLE', 'COMMAND_SENT', 'COMMAND_RECEIVED', 'DIALING', 'RINGING', 'ACTIVE', 'ENDING', 'RECOVERY_REQUIRED', ...terminalStates]);
437
438export function createCallSession(params: {
439  sessionId: string;
440  tenantId: string;
441  userId: string;
442  phoneDeviceId: string;
443  laptopSocketId: string;
444  phoneSocketId: string;
445  leadId?: string;
446  phone: string;
447  name: string;
448  direction: 'OUTBOUND' | 'INCOMING';
449  commandId?: string;
450  campaignId?: string;
451  simSlot?: number | null;
452}): CallSession {
453  const callId = 'call_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + '_' + Date.now().toString(36);
454  const now = new Date().toISOString();
455  const cs: CallSession = {
456    callId,
457    sessionId: params.sessionId,
458    tenantId: params.tenantId,
459    userId: params.userId,
460    phoneDeviceId: params.phoneDeviceId,
461    laptopSocketId: params.laptopSocketId,
462    phoneSocketId: params.phoneSocketId,
463    leadId: params.leadId,
464    phone: params.phone,
465    name: params.name,
466    direction: params.direction,
467    state: 'COMMAND_SENT',
468    commandId: params.commandId,
469    campaignId: params.campaignId,
470    simSlot: params.simSlot,
471    createdAt: now,
472    startedAt: now,
473    duration: 0
474  };
475  activeCallSessions.set(callId, cs);
476  return cs;
477}
478
479export function getCallSession(callId: string): CallSession | undefined {
480  return activeCallSessions.get(callId);
481}
482
483export function getCallSessionBySessionId(sessionId: string): CallSession | undefined {
484  for (const cs of activeCallSessions.values()) {
485    if (cs.sessionId === sessionId && !terminalStates.has(cs.state)) {
486      return cs;
487    }
488  }
489  return undefined;
490}
491
492export function getCallSessionByCommandId(commandId: string): CallSession | undefined {
493  for (const cs of activeCallSessions.values()) {
494    if (cs.commandId === commandId && !terminalStates.has(cs.state)) {
495      return cs;
496    }
497  }
498  return undefined;
499}
500
501export function updateCallSessionState(callId: string, state: CallState, extra?: Partial<CallSession>): CallSession | undefined {
502  const cs = activeCallSessions.get(callId);
503  if (!cs || !allowedStates.has(state) || terminalStates.has(cs.state)) return undefined;
504  if (cs.state === 'ACTIVE' && ['COMMAND_SENT', 'COMMAND_RECEIVED', 'DIALING', 'RINGING'].includes(state)) return undefined;
505  if (cs.state === 'ENDING' && !terminalStates.has(state)) return undefined;
506  cs.state = state;
507  if (terminalStates.has(state)) {
508    cs.endedAt = new Date().toISOString();
509    setTimeout(() => activeCallSessions.delete(callId), 10 * 60 * 1000).unref?.();
510  }
511  if (state === 'ACTIVE' && !cs.activeAt) {
512    cs.activeAt = new Date().toISOString();
513  }
514  if (extra) {
515    Object.assign(cs, extra);
516  }
517  return cs;
518}
519
520export function finalizeCallSession(callId: string, reason: string, duration: number): CallSession | undefined {
521  const cs = activeCallSessions.get(callId);
522  if (!cs) return undefined;
523  cs.state = 'ENDED';
524  cs.endedAt = new Date().toISOString();
525  cs.endReason = reason;
526  cs.duration = duration;
527  // Retain in memory for 10 minutes then prune
528  setTimeout(() => {
529    activeCallSessions.delete(callId);
530  }, 10 * 60 * 1000);
531  return cs;
532}

138              "uploadedAt" = now()
139          `, [
140            `ota_v${this.currentVersion}`,
141            this.currentVersion,
142            this.currentBuildNumber,
143            sha256
144          ]);
145        } catch (dbErr) {
146          console.warn('[APK Watcher] OTA database update notice:', dbErr);
147        }
148      }
149
150      this.lastProcessedMtime = freshest.mtime;
151
152      if (syncedTo.length > 0) {
153        console.log(`[APK Watcher] ✅ Auto-synced new build (${(freshest.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB) from ${freshest.path}`);
154        console.log(`[APK Watcher] Synced targets: ${syncedTo.join(', ')}`);
155        
156        // Broadcast WebSocket OTA event
157        if (this.io) {
158          this.io.emit('ota:update_available', {
159            version: this.currentVersion,
160            buildNumber: this.currentBuildNumber,
161            sha256,
162            downloadUrl: '/download/apk',
163            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
164          });
165        }
166      }
167
168      this.isProcessing = false;
169      return {
170        freshestPath: freshest.path,
171        mtime: freshest.mtime,
172        size: freshest.size,
173        sha256,
174        syncedTo
175      };
176    } catch (err) {
177      console.error('[APK Watcher] Error during sync:', err);
178      this.isProcessing = false;
179      return null;
180    }
181  }
182
183  private startWatching(): void {
184    for (const dir of this.watchDirs) {
185      try {
186        if (fs.existsSync(dir)) {
187          fs.watch(dir, { recursive: false }, (_eventType, filename) => {
188            if (filename && filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.apk')) {
189              console.log(`[APK Watcher] Detected change in ${dir}: ${filename}`);
190              // Debounce 1.5s to ensure Flutter has finished writing the binary
191              setTimeout(() => this.syncFreshestApk(), 1500);
192            }
193          });
194        }
195      } catch (watchErr) {
196        console.warn(`[APK Watcher] Notice: Could not watch directory ${dir}:`, watchErr);
197      }
198    }
199
200    // Periodic safety poll every 30s in case OS watcher drops events
201    setInterval(() => {
202      this.syncFreshestApk();
203    }, 30000);
204  }
205}
206
207export const apkWatcher = ApkWatcher.getInstance();

1/**
2 * db/pool.ts
3 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4 * PostgreSQL Connection Pool & Unified Query Provider for Octal Dialer.
5 * 
6 * Supports:
7 *  - Standard PostgreSQL connections via DATABASE_URL or PGHOST, PGPORT, etc.
8 *  - Connection pooling with sensible defaults, connection timeouts, and leak detection.
9 *  - In-memory PostgreSQL mock (via pg-mem) for isolated local testing without external services.
10 *  - Parameterized helper methods: query(sql, params), withTransaction(fn)
11 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
12 */
13
14import { Pool, PoolClient, QueryResult, QueryResultRow } from 'pg';
15import fs from 'fs';
16import path from 'path';
17import { AsyncLocalStorage } from 'node:async_hooks';
18
19// All adapter helpers inside a transaction must use its checked-out connection.
20const transactionContext = new AsyncLocalStorage<{ client: PoolClient; active: boolean; rollbackOnly: boolean }>();
21
22let pool: Pool | null = null;
23let isInMemory = false;
24
25export function getDatabaseUrl(): string | undefined {
26  if (process.env.DATABASE_URL) return process.env.DATABASE_URL;
27  if (process.env.PGHOST && process.env.PGUSER && process.env.PGDATABASE) {
28    const user = encodeURIComponent(process.env.PGUSER);
29    const pass = process.env.PGPASSWORD ? `:${encodeURIComponent(process.env.PGPASSWORD)}` : '';
30    const host = process.env.PGHOST;
31    const port = process.env.PGPORT || '5432';
32    const db = process.env.PGDATABASE;
33    return `postgresql://${user}${pass}@${host}:${port}/${db}`;
34  }
35  return undefined;
36}
37
38export function initDatabasePool(customUrl?: string): Pool {
39  if (pool) return pool;
40
41  const dbUrl = customUrl || getDatabaseUrl();
42
43  if (dbUrl) {
44    console.log('[PostgreSQL] Connecting to external database...');
45    pool = new Pool({
46      connectionString: dbUrl,
47      max: parseInt(process.env.PG_MAX_CONNECTIONS || '20', 10),
48      idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,
49      connectionTimeoutMillis: 15000,
50    });
51
52    pool.on('error', (err) => {
53      console.error('[PostgreSQL Pool Error]: Unexpected client error', err);
54    });
55
56    isInMemory = false;
57    return pool;
58  }
59
60  // Fallback to in-memory PostgreSQL engine (via pg-mem) ONLY for local development/testing
61  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
62    const errorMsg = '[PostgreSQL Configuration Fatal] NODE_ENV is production, but no PostgreSQL configuration was found. ' +
63      'Production strictly requires DATABASE_URL or (PGHOST, PGUSER, PGDATABASE, PGPASSWORD). ' +
64      'In-memory fallback (pg-mem) is strictly prohibited in production mode.';
65    console.error(errorMsg);
66    throw new Error(errorMsg);
67  }
68
69  console.log('[PostgreSQL] No DATABASE_URL found. Initializing in-memory PostgreSQL provider (pg-mem) for local testing...');
70  try {
71    const { newDb, DataType } = require('pg-mem');
72    const memDb = newDb();
73    
74    // Register common PostgreSQL functions
75    memDb.public.registerFunction({
76      name: 'now',
77      implementation: () => new Date().toISOString()
78    });
79    memDb.public.registerFunction({
80      name: 'hashtext',
81      args: [DataType.text],
82      returns: DataType.integer,
83      implementation: (str: string) => {
84        let hash = 0;
85        const s = String(str || '');
86        for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
87          hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + s.charCodeAt(i);
88          hash |= 0;
89        }
90        return hash;
91      }
92    });
93    memDb.public.registerFunction({
94      name: 'pg_advisory_xact_lock',
95      args: [DataType.integer, DataType.integer],
96      returns: DataType.null,
97      implementation: () => null
98    });
99
100    const pgAdapter = memDb.adapters.createPg();
101    pool = new pgAdapter.Pool() as Pool;
102    (pool as any)._memDb = memDb;
103    isInMemory = true;
104    return pool;
105  } catch (err) {
106    console.error('[PostgreSQL] Failed to initialize in-memory fallback:', err);
107    throw new Error('PostgreSQL configuration missing and pg-mem fallback failed.');
108  }
109}
110
111export function getPool(): Pool {
112  if (!pool) {
113    return initDatabasePool();
114  }
115  return pool;
116}
117
118export function isInMemoryDatabase(): boolean {
119  return isInMemory;
120}
121
122/**
123 * Execute a parameterized query against the PostgreSQL pool.
124 */
125export async function query<T extends QueryResultRow = any>(
126  text: string,
127  params?: any[]
128): Promise<QueryResult<T>> {
129  const transaction = transactionContext.getStore();
130  if (transaction && !transaction.active) throw new Error('Query attempted after transaction completed. Await all transaction work.');
131  const p = transaction?.client || getPool();
132  const start = Date.now();
133  try {
134    const res = await p.query<T>(text, params);
135    return res;
136  } catch (err: any) {
137    const duration = Date.now() - start;
138    console.error(`[PostgreSQL Query Error] (${duration}ms):`, {
139      message: err.message,
140      query: text.slice(0, 150),
141      paramCount: params ? params.length : 0
142    });
143    throw err;
144  }
145}
146
147/**
148 * Execute a scoped callback within a managed PostgreSQL transaction.
149 */
150export async function withTransaction<T>(
151  callback: (client: PoolClient) => Promise<T>
152): Promise<T> {
153  const parent = transactionContext.getStore();
154  if (parent) {
155    if (!parent.active) throw new Error('Transaction already completed.');
156    try {
157      return await callback(parent.client);
158    } catch (err) {
159      parent.rollbackOnly = true;
160      throw err;
161    }
162  }
163  const p = getPool();
164  if (isInMemory && (p as any)._memDb) {
165    const backup = (p as any)._memDb.backup();
166    const client = await p.connect();
167    const context = { client, active: true, rollbackOnly: false };
168    try {
169      const result = await transactionContext.run(context, () => callback(client));
170      if (context.rollbackOnly) throw new Error('Transaction aborted by nested operation.');
171      return result;
172    } catch (err) {
173      backup.restore();
174      throw err;
175    } finally {
176      context.active = false;
177      client.release();
178    }
179  }
180
181  const client = await p.connect();
182  const context = { client, active: true, rollbackOnly: false };
183  try {
184    await client.query('BEGIN');
185    const result = await transactionContext.run(context, () => callback(client));
186    if (context.rollbackOnly) throw new Error('Transaction aborted by nested operation.');
187    await client.query('COMMIT');
188    return result;
189  } catch (err) {
190    try { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); } catch (rollbackError) {
191      console.error('[PostgreSQL] Rollback failed:', rollbackError);
192    }
193    throw err;
194  } finally {
195    context.active = false;
196    client.release();
197  }
198}

200/**
201 * Execute schema DDL initialization script
202 */
203export function findSchemaFilePath(): string {
204  const candidates = [
205    path.join(__dirname, 'schema.sql'),
206    path.join(__dirname, '../../src/db/schema.sql'),
207    path.join(process.cwd(), 'src/db/schema.sql'),
208    path.join(process.cwd(), 'dist/db/schema.sql')
209  ];
210  for (const p of candidates) {
211    if (fs.existsSync(p)) return p;
212  }
213  return candidates[0];
214}
215
216const ADVISORY_LOCK_ID = 987654321;
217
218let schemaInitPromise: Promise<void> | null = null;
219
220export function initializeSchema(schemaFilePath?: string): Promise<void> {
221  if (schemaInitPromise) {
222    return schemaInitPromise;
223  }
224
225  schemaInitPromise = (async () => {
226    const schemaPath = schemaFilePath && fs.existsSync(schemaFilePath) ? schemaFilePath : findSchemaFilePath();
227    if (!fs.existsSync(schemaPath)) {
228      throw new Error(`Schema file not found at: ${schemaPath}`);
229    }
230    let ddl = fs.readFileSync(schemaPath, 'utf-8');
231    if (ddl.charCodeAt(0) === 0xFEFF) {
232      ddl = ddl.slice(1);
233    }
234
235    let dedicatedClient: PoolClient | null = null;
236    let lockAcquired = false;
237
238    // Multi-instance concurrency protection: Check out a dedicated connection for advisory lock on real databases
239    if (!isInMemoryDatabase()) {
240      const p = getPool();
241      try {
242        dedicatedClient = await p.connect();
243        // Set bounded statement and lock timeouts on the migration connection
244        await dedicatedClient.query('SET statement_timeout = 60000');
245        await dedicatedClient.query('SET lock_timeout = 30000');
246        await dedicatedClient.query('SELECT pg_advisory_lock($1)', [ADVISORY_LOCK_ID]);
247        lockAcquired = true;
248      } catch (e: any) {
249        console.error('[PostgreSQL] Failed to acquire advisory lock for schema migration:', e.message);
250        if (dedicatedClient) {
251          try { dedicatedClient.release(true); } catch (_) {}
252          dedicatedClient = null;
253        }
254        throw new Error(`Migration advisory lock acquisition failed: ${e.message}`);
255      }
256    }
257
258    const runStmt = async <T extends QueryResultRow = any>(stmt: string, params?: any[]): Promise<QueryResult<T>> => {
259      if (dedicatedClient) {
260        return await dedicatedClient.query<T>(stmt, params);
261      }
262      return await query<T>(stmt, params);
263    };
264
265    try {
266      // 1. Run baseline schema DDL
267      const cleanDdl = ddl.replace(/--.*$/gm, '');
268      const statements = cleanDdl
269        .split(';')
270        .map(s => s.trim())
271        .filter(s => s.length > 0);
272
273      for (const stmt of statements) {
274        try {
275          await runStmt(stmt);
276        } catch (e: any) {
277          const ignorable =
278            e.message?.includes('already exists') ||
279            e.message?.includes('duplicate key') ||
280            e.message?.includes('multiple primary keys') ||
281            e.message?.includes('parts have not been read');
282          if (ignorable) {
283            continue;
284          }
285          console.error(`[Schema Init Fatal] Statement failed: ${stmt.slice(0, 80)}... => ${e.message}`);
286          throw new Error(`Schema initialization failed on statement: ${stmt.slice(0, 60)}... Error: ${e.message}`);
287        }
288      }
289
290      // 2. Ensure schema_migrations table exists for versioned migration tracking
291      try {
292        await runStmt(`
293          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
294            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
295            name TEXT,
296            appliedAt TEXT
297          );
298        `);
299      } catch (e: any) {
300        if (!e.message?.includes('already exists') && !e.message?.includes('parts have not been read')) {
301          throw e;
302        }
303      }
304
305      // Ensure revoked_tokens table exists for stateless token revocation
306      try {
307        await runStmt(`
308          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revoked_tokens (
309            token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
310            "revokedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
311            "expiresAt" TEXT NOT NULL
312          );
313        `);
314        await runStmt(`
315          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_revoked_tokens_expiresAt ON revoked_tokens("expiresAt");
316        `);
317      } catch (e: any) {
318        if (!e.message?.includes('already exists') && !e.message?.includes('parts have not been read')) {
319          throw e;
320        }
321      }
322
323      // 3. Find and run incremental migrations on real PostgreSQL from src/db/migrations
324      if (!isInMemoryDatabase()) {
325        const migrationsDirCandidates = [
326          path.join(__dirname, 'migrations'),
327          path.join(__dirname, '../../src/db/migrations'),
328          path.join(process.cwd(), 'src/db/migrations'),
329          path.join(process.cwd(), 'dist/db/migrations')
330        ];
331        let migrationsDir: string | null = null;
332        for (const dir of migrationsDirCandidates) {
333          if (fs.existsSync(dir)) {
334            migrationsDir = dir;
335            break;
336          }
337        }
338
339        if (!migrationsDir) {
340          throw new Error('[PostgreSQL Migrations Fatal] Migration directory not found in any expected paths: ' + migrationsDirCandidates.join(', '));
341        }
342
343        const appliedRows = await runStmt<{ id: string }>('SELECT id FROM schema_migrations');
344        const appliedSet = new Set(appliedRows.rows.map(r => r.id));
345
346        const files = fs.readdirSync(migrationsDir)
347          .filter(f => f.endsWith('.sql'))
348          .sort();
349
350        for (const file of files) {
351          const migrationId = file.replace(/\.sql$/, '');
352          if (appliedSet.has(migrationId)) {
353            continue;
354          }
355
356          const sqlFile = path.join(migrationsDir, file);
357          let migrationSql = fs.readFileSync(sqlFile, 'utf-8');
358          if (migrationSql.charCodeAt(0) === 0xFEFF) {
359            migrationSql = migrationSql.slice(1);
360          }
361
362          // Wrap each transactional migration and its applied-marker insertion in the same transaction
363          await runStmt('BEGIN');
364          try {
365            await runStmt(migrationSql);
366            await runStmt(
367              'INSERT INTO schema_migrations (id, name, appliedAt) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING',
368              [migrationId, file, new Date().toISOString()]
369            );
370            await runStmt('COMMIT');
371            console.log(`[PostgreSQL Migrations] Applied: ${file}`);
372          } catch (migErr: any) {
373            await runStmt('ROLLBACK');
374            console.error(`[PostgreSQL Migrations] Failed applying migration ${file}:`, migErr.message);
375            throw migErr;
376          }
377        }
378      }
379
380      console.log('[PostgreSQL] Schema initialized successfully (all tables ready).');
381    } finally {
382      if (dedicatedClient) {
383        let discardConnection = false;
384        if (lockAcquired) {
385          try {
386            const unlockRes = await dedicatedClient.query('SELECT pg_advisory_unlock($1)', [ADVISORY_LOCK_ID]);
387            const unlocked = unlockRes.rows[0]?.pg_advisory_unlock;
388            if (unlocked !== true) {
389              console.warn('[PostgreSQL] Advisory unlock returned false or lock not held. Connection lock ownership uncertain.');
390              discardConnection = true;
391            }
392          } catch (e: any) {
393            console.warn('[PostgreSQL] Advisory lock release warning:', e.message);
394            discardConnection = true;
395          }
396        }
397        try {
398          await dedicatedClient.query('RESET statement_timeout; RESET lock_timeout;');
399        } catch (resetErr: any) {
400          console.warn('[PostgreSQL] Reset session timeouts warning:', resetErr.message);
401          discardConnection = true;
402        }
403
404        try {
405          if (discardConnection) {
406            console.warn('[PostgreSQL] Discarding migration connection from pool due to uncertain lock state or reset failure.');
407            dedicatedClient.release(true);
408          } else {
409            dedicatedClient.release();
410          }
411        } catch (releaseErr: any) {
412          console.warn('[PostgreSQL] Dedicated client release warning:', releaseErr.message);
413        }
414      }
415    }
416  })().catch(err => {
417    schemaInitPromise = null;
418    throw err;
419  });
420
421  return schemaInitPromise;
422}
423
424/**
425 * Ping database to verify connection health
426 */
427export async function pingDatabase(): Promise<boolean> {
428  try {
429    const res = await query('SELECT 1 as alive');
430    return res.rows.length > 0 && (res.rows[0] as any).alive === 1;
431  } catch (err) {
432    console.error('[PostgreSQL Health Check Failed]:', err);
433    return false;
434  }
435}
436
437/**
438 * Close pool during graceful shutdown
439 */
440export async function closePool(): Promise<void> {
441  if (pool) {
442    await pool.end();
443    pool = null;
444  }
445}

1/**2 * db/dbAdapter.ts3 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────4 * PostgreSQL Database Adapter for Octal Dialer.5 *6 * This is the ONLY production database adapter.7 * All operations are asynchronous and route through src/db/pool.ts → pg.Pool → PostgreSQL.8 *9 * SQLite is NOT available through this adapter.10 * SQLite exists ONLY in isolated migration tooling (src/db/migrator.ts).11 *12 * Provides:13 *  - query<T>(sql, params)        → { rows: T[], rowCount: number }14 *  - queryOne<T>(sql, params)     → T | undefined15 *  - queryAll<T>(sql, params)     → T[]16 *  - execute(sql, params)         → { rowCount: number, rows: any[] }17 *  - withTransaction<T>(fn)       → T18 *  - init()                       → void (initializes pool + schema)19 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────20 */2122import path from 'path';23import { QueryResultRow } from 'pg';24import { getPool, query as pgQuery, withTransaction as pgWithTransaction, initializeSchema } from './pool';2526/**27 * Transform SQL for PostgreSQL compatibility:28 *  - Convert ? placeholders to $1, $2, $3 positional params29 *  - Convert @named placeholders to $1, $2, $3 positional params30 *  - Rewrite INSERT OR IGNORE → INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING31 *  - Rewrite datetime('now') → now()32 */33export function transformSql(sql: string, params: any[] = []): { sql: string; params: any[] } {34  let finalSql = sql;35  let finalParams: any[] = [];3637  // Check if parameters passed as a single named-property object38  if (params.length === 1 && params[0] !== null && typeof params[0] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(params[0])) {39    const obj = params[0];40    let idx = 1;41    finalSql = finalSql.replace(/@([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g, (_, name) => {42      finalParams.push(obj[name]);43      return `$${idx++}`;44    });45  } else {46    finalParams = params.flat();47    let idx = 1;48    let inStr = false;49    let quoteChar = '';50    let out = '';51    for (let i = 0; i < finalSql.length; i++) {52      const c = finalSql[i];53      if (!inStr && (c === "'" || c === '"')) {54        inStr = true;55        quoteChar = c;56        out += c;57      } else if (inStr && c === quoteChar) {58        inStr = false;59        out += c;60      } else if (!inStr && c === '?') {61        out += `$${idx++}`;62      } else {63        out += c;64      }65    }66    finalSql = out;67  }6869  // Rewrite SQLite conflict syntax to PostgreSQL standard70  if (/INSERT\s+OR\s+IGNORE\s+INTO/i.test(finalSql)) {71    finalSql = finalSql.replace(/INSERT\s+OR\s+IGNORE\s+INTO/gi, 'INSERT INTO');72    if (!finalSql.includes('ON CONFLICT')) {73      finalSql += ' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING';74    }75  }7677  // Remove SQLite datetime('now') -> now()78  finalSql = finalSql.replace(/datetime\('now'\)/gi, 'now()');7980  return { sql: finalSql, params: finalParams };81}8283/**84 * PostgreSQL-only database adapter.85 * All methods are asynchronous. No SQLite fallback.86 */87export class DbAdapter {88  private initialized = false;89  private initPromise: Promise<void> | null = null;9091  public async init(): Promise<void> {92    if (this.initialized) return;93    if (this.initPromise) return this.initPromise;9495    this.initPromise = (async () => {96      console.log('[DbAdapter] Initializing PostgreSQL engine...');97      getPool();98      await initializeSchema(path.join(__dirname, 'schema.sql'));99      console.log('[DbAdapter] PostgreSQL engine online and schema ready.');100      this.initialized = true;101    })();102103    try {104      await this.initPromise;105    } catch (err) {106      this.initPromise = null;107      throw err;108    }109  }110111  public async query<T extends QueryResultRow = any>(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise<{ rows: T[]; rowCount: number }> {112    const { sql: pgSql, params: pgParams } = transformSql(sql, params);113    const result = await pgQuery<T>(pgSql, pgParams);114    return {115      rows: result.rows,116      rowCount: result.rowCount || 0117    };118  }119120  public async queryOne<T extends QueryResultRow = any>(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise<T | undefined> {121    const res = await this.query<T>(sql, params);122    return res.rows[0];123  }124125  public async queryAll<T extends QueryResultRow = any>(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise<T[]> {126    const res = await this.query<T>(sql, params);127    return res.rows;128  }129130  public async execute(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise<{ rowCount: number; rows: any[] }> {131    return this.query(sql, params);132  }133134  public async withTransaction<T>(fn: (client: any) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {135    return pgWithTransaction(fn);136  }137}138139export const dbAdapter = new DbAdapter();140export default dbAdapter;141

327    let oauthToken = urlParams.get('token');
328    let oauthUser = urlParams.get('displayName') || urlParams.get('username') || urlParams.get('user') || 'Google User';
329    const authError = urlParams.get('auth_error');
330
331    // Check URL fragment/hash for impersonation token and tenant (#impersonateToken=...&impersonateTenant=...)
332    // Also supports secure fragment-based OAuth tokens (#token=...) to avoid query string exposure
333    let hashImpToken: string | null = null;
334    let hashImpTenant: string | null = null;
335    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.hash && window.location.hash.startsWith('#')) {
336      const hashParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.slice(1));
337      hashImpToken = hashParams.get('impersonateToken');
338      hashImpTenant = hashParams.get('impersonateTenant');
339      if (hashParams.get('token')) {
340        oauthToken = hashParams.get('token');
341        oauthUser = hashParams.get('displayName') || hashParams.get('username') || hashParams.get('user') || 'Google User';
342      }
343    }
344
345    let currentToken = effectiveAuthToken;
346
347    if (hashImpToken) {
348      sessionStorage.setItem('octal_impersonate_token', hashImpToken);
349      if (hashImpTenant) sessionStorage.setItem('octal_impersonate_tenant', hashImpTenant);
350      setImpersonateToken(hashImpToken);
351      setImpersonateTenant(hashImpTenant || 'Tenant Organization');
352      currentToken = hashImpToken;
353      const hint = getInitialIdentityHintFromToken(hashImpToken);
354      if (hint) setAuthIdentity(hint);
355      // Immediately clear fragment with replaceState, preserving search if any
356      window.history.replaceState(null, document.title, window.location.pathname + window.location.search);
357    } else if (oauthToken) {
358      localStorage.setItem('octal_auth_token', oauthToken);
359      localStorage.setItem('octal_auth_user', oauthUser);
360      setAuthToken(oauthToken);
361      setAuthUser(oauthUser);
362      currentToken = oauthToken;
363      const hint = getInitialIdentityHintFromToken(oauthToken);
364      if (hint) setAuthIdentity(hint);
365      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
366    } else if (authError) {
367      setToast({ message: `Authentication notice: ${authError}`, type: 'info' });
368      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
369    }

371    const verifyToken = async () => {
372      if (!currentToken) {
373        setAuthChecked(true);
374        return;
375      }
376      const controller = new AbortController();
377      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 3000);
378      try {
379        const res = await fetch(`${WEB_API_BASE}/auth/verify`, {
380          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${currentToken}` },
381          signal: controller.signal
382        });
383        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
384        if (res.ok) {
385          const data = await res.json();
386          const preferredName = data.user?.displayName || data.user?.username;
387          const verifiedRole = tryNormalizeStructuralRole(data.user?.role || data.role);
388          if (verifiedRole) {
389            setAuthIdentity(prev => ({
390              username: preferredName || prev?.username || 'user',
391              role: verifiedRole,
392              displayName: preferredName || prev?.displayName,
393              tenantId: data.tenantId || prev?.tenantId,
394              userId: data.user?.id || prev?.userId,
395              email: data.user?.email || prev?.email,
396              needsOnboarding: data.needsOnboarding ?? (!data.tenantId && !data.pendingInvitation),
397              pendingInvitation: data.pendingInvitation

402            if (!sessionStorage.getItem('octal_impersonate_token')) {
403              localStorage.setItem('octal_auth_user', preferredName);
404            }
405          }
406        } else if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
407          // Token strictly rejected by server
408          if (sessionStorage.getItem('octal_impersonate_token')) {
409            sessionStorage.removeItem('octal_impersonate_token');
410            sessionStorage.removeItem('octal_impersonate_tenant');

412          } else {

414            localStorage.removeItem('octal_auth_user');
415            setAuthToken(null);
416            setAuthUser(null);
417            setAuthIdentity(null);
418          }
419        }
420      } catch (err) {
421        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
422        console.warn('Notice: token verification network check skipped:', err);
423      } finally {
424        setAuthChecked(true);
425      }
426    };
427    verifyToken();
428  }, []);

260        try {
261          const controller = new AbortController();
262          const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2500);
263          res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/auth/google/initiate`, {
264            method: 'POST',
265            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
266            body: JSON.stringify({ intent, captchaToken }),
267            signal: controller.signal
268          });
269          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
270          if (res && res.ok) break;
271        } catch {}
272      }
273
274      if (res && res.ok) {
275        const data = await res.json();
276        if (data.authUrl) {
277          window.location.href = data.authUrl;
278          return;
279        }
280      }
281
282      window.location.href = `${serverUrl}/auth/google?intent=${intent}`;
283    } catch (err: any) {
284      setError(err.message || 'Failed to initiate Google authentication.');
285      setLoading(false);
286    }
287  };

289  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
290    e.preventDefault();
291    setError(null);
292    setSuccessMsg(null);
293
294    if (mode === 'register') {
295      if (!businessName.trim()) {
296        setError('Please enter your Business Name.');
297        return;
298      }
299      if (!firstName.trim()) {
300        setError('Please enter your First Name.');
301        return;
302      }
303      if (!lastName.trim()) {
304        setError('Please enter your Last Name.');
305        return;
306      }
307      if (!email.trim()) {
308        setError('Please enter your Email Address.');
309        return;
310      }
311      if (!password || password.length < 6) {
312        setError('Password must be at least 6 characters.');
313        return;
314      }
315      if (!mobile.trim()) {
316        setError('Please enter your Mobile number.');
317        return;
318      }
319
320      // Persist business name & mobile for seamless onboarding wizard prefill
321      localStorage.setItem('pending_business_name', businessName.trim());
322      localStorage.setItem('pending_mobile', mobile.trim());
323    } else if (mode === 'forgot') {
324      if (!username.trim() && !email.trim()) {
325        setError('Please provide your email address or username.');
326        return;
327      }
328    } else {
329      if (!username.trim()) {
330        setError('Please enter your User Name / Email.');
331        return;
332      }
333      if (!password) {
334        setError('Please enter your password.');
335        return;
336      }
337    }
338
339    setLoading(true);
340
341    try {
342      const isLocal = typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
343        (window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1');
344
345      const candidateUrls: string[] = [''];
346      if (serverUrl && !candidateUrls.includes(serverUrl)) {
347        candidateUrls.push(serverUrl);
348      }
349      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.origin && !candidateUrls.includes(window.location.origin)) {
350        candidateUrls.push(window.location.origin);
351      }
352      if (isLocal) {
353        candidateUrls.push('http://127.0.0.1:5000');
354        candidateUrls.push(`http://${window.location.hostname}:5000`);
355      }
356
357      let res: Response | null = null;
358
359      for (const baseUrl of candidateUrls) {
360        try {
361          const cleanBase = baseUrl ? baseUrl.replace(/\/$/, '') : '';
362          let endpoint = `${cleanBase}/auth/login`;
363          let payload: any = { username: username.trim(), password, captchaToken };
364
365          if (mode === 'register') {
366            const finalFullName = `${firstName.trim()} ${lastName.trim()}`.trim();
367            endpoint = `${cleanBase}/auth/register`;
368            payload = {
369              name: finalFullName,
370              fullName: finalFullName,
371              email: email.trim(),
372              password,
373              businessName: businessName.trim(),
374              mobile: mobile.trim(),
375              captchaToken
376            };
377          } else if (mode === 'forgot') {
378            endpoint = `${cleanBase}/auth/forgot-password`;
379            payload = { identifier: (email || username).trim(), captchaToken };
380          }
381
382          const controller = new AbortController();
383          const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 8000);
384
385          const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
386            method: 'POST',
387            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
388            body: JSON.stringify(payload),
389            signal: controller.signal
390          });
391          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
392          res = response;
393          if (res) break;
394        } catch (fetchErr: any) {
395          console.warn('[LoginScreen] Candidate endpoint unreachable:', baseUrl, fetchErr?.message || fetchErr);
396        }
397      }
398
399      if (!res) {
400        setError('Cannot reach backend server. Please ensure backend is running.');
401        return;
402      }
403
404      const data = await res.json();
405
406      if (!res.ok) {
407        setError(data.error || 'Operation failed.');
408        return;
409      }
410
411      if (mode === 'forgot') {
412        setSuccessMsg(data.message || 'Password reset link issued. Check your email.');
413        return;
414      }
415
416      // Successful Login / Register -> Authenticate user
417      const token = data.token;
418      const returnedUser = data.user?.username || data.username || username || (email ? email.split('@')[0] : 'user');
419      const rawRole = data.user?.role || data.role || 'user';
420      const normalizedRole = tryNormalizeStructuralRole(rawRole) || 'user';
421      const identity: AuthIdentity = {
422        username: returnedUser,
423        role: normalizedRole,
424        displayName: data.user?.displayName || (firstName && lastName ? `${firstName} ${lastName}` : returnedUser),
425        tenantId: data.user?.tenantId || data.tenantId,
426        userId: data.user?.id || data.id,
427        email: data.user?.email || data.email || email,
428        needsOnboarding: data.needsOnboarding,
429        pendingInvitation: data.pendingInvitation
430      };
431
432      if (normalizedRole === 'platform_admin') {
433        localStorage.setItem('octal_platform_auth_token', token);
434        localStorage.setItem('octal_platform_auth_user', returnedUser);
435      } else {
436        localStorage.setItem('octal_customer_auth_token', token);
437        localStorage.setItem('octal_customer_auth_user', returnedUser);
438        localStorage.setItem('octal_auth_token', token);
439        localStorage.setItem('octal_auth_user', returnedUser);
440      }
441      onLogin(token, identity);
442    } catch (err: any) {
443      setError(err.message || 'Cannot reach server. Make sure the backend is active.');
444    } finally {
445      setLoading(false);
446    }
447  };

1import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
2import { Database, Download, Filter, RefreshCw, CheckSquare, Square } from 'lucide-react';
3import { LeadProfileDrawer } from './crm/LeadProfileDrawer';
4
5interface Lead {
6  id: string;
7  source: string;
8  businessName: string | null;
9  phone: string | null;
10  email: string | null;
11  address: string | null;
12  website: string | null;
13  status: 'new' | 'contacted' | 'converted' | 'invalid';
14  scrapedBy: string;
15  scrapedAt: string;
16}
17
18interface LeadsTableProps {
19  isLight?: boolean;
20  serverUrl: string;
21  authToken: string;
22  contextSource?: string; // If provided, auto-filter by this source
23}
24
25export const LeadsTable: React.FC<LeadsTableProps> = ({ isLight, serverUrl, authToken, contextSource }) => {
26  const [leads, setLeads] = useState<Lead[]>([]);
27  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
28  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
29  const [selectedLeads, setSelectedLeads] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
30  const [selectedLeadForDrawer, setSelectedLeadForDrawer] = useState<string | null>(null);
31
32  // Filters
33  const [sourceFilter, setSourceFilter] = useState(contextSource || '');
34  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');
35  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
36  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
37  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
38
39  const fetchLeads = async () => {
40    setLoading(true);
41    setError(null);
42    try {
43      const params = new URLSearchParams({
44        page: page.toString(),
45        limit: '50'
46      });
47      if (sourceFilter) params.append('source', sourceFilter);
48      if (statusFilter) params.append('status', statusFilter);
49
50      const targetUrl = serverUrl && serverUrl.startsWith('http') ? serverUrl : window.location.origin;
51      const res = await fetch(`${targetUrl}/leads?${params}`, {
52        headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${authToken}` }
53      });
54
55      if (res.ok) {
56        const data = await res.json();
57        setLeads(data.leads || []);
58        setTotalPages(data.pagination?.totalPages || 1);
59        setTotal(data.pagination?.total || 0);
60      } else {
61        const errorData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
62        setError(errorData.error || 'Failed to fetch leads');
63      }
64    } catch {
65      setError('Connection error while fetching leads');
66    } finally {
67      setLoading(false);
68    }
69  };
70
71  useEffect(() => {
72    fetchLeads();
73  }, [page, sourceFilter, statusFilter, serverUrl, authToken]);
74
75  const handleToggleSelect = (leadId: string) => {
76    const newSelected = new Set(selectedLeads);
77    if (newSelected.has(leadId)) {
78      newSelected.delete(leadId);
79    } else {
80      newSelected.add(leadId);
81    }
82    setSelectedLeads(newSelected);
83  };
84
85  const handleSelectAll = () => {
86    if (selectedLeads.size === leads.length) {
87      setSelectedLeads(new Set());
88    } else {
89      setSelectedLeads(new Set(leads.map(l => l.id)));
90    }
91  };
92
93  const handleBulkStatusUpdate = async (status: string) => {
94    if (selectedLeads.size === 0) return;
95
96    try {
97      const targetUrl = serverUrl && serverUrl.startsWith('http') ? serverUrl : window.location.origin;
98      const updatePromises = Array.from(selectedLeads).map(id =>
99        fetch(`${targetUrl}/leads/${id}`, {
100          method: 'PATCH',
101          headers: {
102            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
103            'Authorization': `Bearer ${authToken}`
104          },
105          body: JSON.stringify({ status })
106        })
107      );
108
109      const results = await Promise.all(updatePromises);
110      if (results.some(result => !result.ok)) throw new Error('One or more lead updates failed.');
111      setSelectedLeads(new Set());
112      fetchLeads();
113    } catch {
114      setError('Failed to update leads');
115    }
116  };
117
118  const handleExport = async () => {
119    try {
120      const params = new URLSearchParams({ format: 'csv' });
121      if (sourceFilter) params.append('source', sourceFilter);
122      if (statusFilter) params.append('status', statusFilter);
123
124      const targetUrl = serverUrl && serverUrl.startsWith('http') ? serverUrl : window.location.origin;
125      const res = await fetch(`${targetUrl}/api/leads/export?${params}`, {
126        headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${authToken}` }
127      });
128      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to export leads');
129      const blob = await res.blob();
130      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
131      const a = document.createElement('a');
132      a.href = url;
133      a.download = `octal_dialer_leads_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;
134      document.body.appendChild(a);
135      a.click();
136      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
137      document.body.removeChild(a);
138    } catch (err: any) {
139      setError('Failed to export leads: ' + err.message);
140    }
141  };
142
143  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
144    const styles = {
145      new: isLight ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200' : 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30',
146      contacted: isLight ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200' : 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30',
147      converted: isLight ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200' : 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30',
148      invalid: isLight ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200' : 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30'
149    };
150    return styles[status as keyof typeof styles] || styles.new;
151  };
152
153  return (
154    <div className={`h-full w-full overflow-y-auto ${isLight ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-900' : 'bg-black text-slate-100'}`}>
155      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
156        
157        {/* Top Header Card */}
158        <div className={`p-6 border rounded-2xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 transition-colors ${
159          isLight ? 'bg-white border-slate-200 shadow-sm' : 'bg-[#09090b] border-[#18181b] shadow-2xl'
160        }`}>
161          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
162            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-center">
163              <Database className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
164            </div>
165            <div>
166              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
167                <h1 className={`text-xl font-black font-display tracking-tight ${isLight ? 'text-slate-900' : 'text-white'}`}>
168                  Central Leads Database
169                </h1>
170                <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono font-bold bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30">
171                  {total.toLocaleString()} leads
172                </span>
173              </div>
174              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
175                Browse, search, and manage leads synced across campaigns and scrapers.
176              </p>
177            </div>
178          </div>
179
180          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
181            <button
182              onClick={fetchLeads}
183              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
184                isLight
185                  ? 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 border border-slate-200'
186                  : 'bg-[#18181b] hover:bg-[#27272a] text-zinc-200 border border-[#27272a]'
187              }`}
188            >
189              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
190              <span>Refresh</span>
191            </button>
192            <button
193              onClick={handleExport}
194              className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-black font-bold text-xs px-4 py-2 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
195            >
196              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
197              <span>Export CSV</span>
198            </button>
199          </div>
200        </div>
201
202        {/* Filters Card */}
203        <div className={`p-5 rounded-2xl border transition-colors ${
204          isLight ? 'bg-white border-slate-200' : 'bg-[#09090b] border-[#18181b] shadow-xl'
205        }`}>
206          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 select-none">

1import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
2import { ShieldCheck, X, Clock } from 'lucide-react';
3
4export interface DispositionResult {
5  success: boolean;
6  message?: string;
7  nextLeadId?: string | null;
8  nextLead?: {
9    id: string;
10    name: string;
11    phone: string;
12    campaignId: string;
13    status: string;
14  } | null;
15}
16
17interface DispositionModalProps {
18  isOpen: boolean;
19  leadId: string;
20  leadName: string;
21  initialOutcome?: string;
22  onClose: () => void;
23  serverUrl: string;
24  authToken?: string;
25  onSaveSuccess: (result?: DispositionResult) => void;
26  isLight?: boolean;
27}
28
29export const DispositionModal: React.FC<DispositionModalProps> = ({
30  isOpen,
31  leadId,
32  leadName,
33  initialOutcome = 'ANSWERED',
34  onClose,
35  serverUrl,
36  authToken,
37  onSaveSuccess,
38  isLight
39}) => {
40  const [outcome, setOutcome] = useState(initialOutcome);
41  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
42  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
43  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null);
44  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(60);
45
46  const outcomeRef = useRef(outcome);
47  const notesRef = useRef(notes);
48  const isSavingRef = useRef(false);
49  const autoSaveTimerRef = useRef<any>(null);
50
51  useEffect(() => {
52    outcomeRef.current = outcome;
53  }, [outcome]);
54
55  useEffect(() => {
56    notesRef.current = notes;
57  }, [notes]);
58
59  const handleClose = () => {
60    if (autoSaveTimerRef.current) {
61      clearInterval(autoSaveTimerRef.current);
62      autoSaveTimerRef.current = null;
63    }
64    onClose();
65  };
66
67  const handleAutoSave = async () => {
68    if (isSavingRef.current) return;
69    isSavingRef.current = true;
70    setSaving(true);
71    try {
72      const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
73      if (authToken) {
74        headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${authToken}`;
75      }
76      const finalNotes = notesRef.current.trim() 
77        ? `${notesRef.current.trim()} [Auto-saved (Timeout)]` 
78        : '[Auto-saved (Timeout)]';
79      const res = await fetch(`${serverUrl}/api/logs/update`, {
80        method: 'POST',
81        headers,
82        body: JSON.stringify({
83          leadId,
84          outcome: outcomeRef.current || 'ANSWERED',
85          notes: finalNotes
86        })
87      });
88      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Disposition was not saved. Please retry.');
89      const data: DispositionResult = await res.json();
90      if (!data.success) throw new Error('Disposition was not acknowledged. Please retry.');
91      onSaveSuccess(data);
92      handleClose();
93    } catch (err) {
94      console.error('Error auto-saving disposition:', err);
95      setSaveError('Auto-save failed. Your notes are still here; please retry.');
96    } finally {
97      setSaving(false);
98      isSavingRef.current = false;
99    }
100  };
101
102  useEffect(() => {
103    if (!isOpen) {
104      if (autoSaveTimerRef.current) {
105        clearInterval(autoSaveTimerRef.current);
106        autoSaveTimerRef.current = null;
107      }
108      return;
109    }
110
111    setSaveError(null);
112    setOutcome(initialOutcome || 'ANSWERED');
113    setNotes('');
114    setTimeLeft(60);
115    isSavingRef.current = false;
116
117    autoSaveTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
118      setTimeLeft(prev => {
119        if (prev <= 1) {
120          if (autoSaveTimerRef.current) {
121            clearInterval(autoSaveTimerRef.current);
122            autoSaveTimerRef.current = null;
123          }
124          handleAutoSave();
125          return 0;
126        }
127        return prev - 1;
128      });
129    }, 1000);
130
131    return () => {
132      if (autoSaveTimerRef.current) {
133        clearInterval(autoSaveTimerRef.current);
134        autoSaveTimerRef.current = null;
135      }
136    };
137  }, [isOpen, initialOutcome, leadId]);
138
139  useEffect(() => {
140    if (!isOpen) return;
141    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
142      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
143        handleClose();
144      }
145    };
146    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
147    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
148  }, [isOpen]);
149
150  if (!isOpen) return null;
151
152  const handleSave = async () => {
153    if (isSavingRef.current) return;
154    isSavingRef.current = true;
155    if (autoSaveTimerRef.current) {
156      clearInterval(autoSaveTimerRef.current);
157      autoSaveTimerRef.current = null;
158    }
159    setSaving(true);
160    try {
161      const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
162      if (authToken) {
163        headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${authToken}`;
164      }
165      const res = await fetch(`${serverUrl}/api/logs/update`, {
166        method: 'POST',
167        headers,
168        body: JSON.stringify({ leadId, outcome, notes })
169      });
170      if (res.ok) {
171        const data: DispositionResult = await res.json();
172        if (!data.success) throw new Error('Disposition was not acknowledged.');
173        onSaveSuccess(data);
174        handleClose();
175      } else {
176        throw new Error('Disposition was not saved.');
177      }
178    } catch (err) {
179      console.error('Error saving disposition:', err);
180      setSaveError('Save failed. Your notes are still here; please retry.');
181    } finally {
182      setSaving(false);
183      isSavingRef.current = false;
184    }
185  };
186
187  return (
188    <div
189      onClick={(e) => {
190        if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !saving) {
191          handleClose();
192        }
193      }}
194      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 text-left backdrop-blur-md bg-black/80 select-none"
195    >
196      <div className={`border p-6 rounded-2xl max-w-sm w-full space-y-4 shadow-2xl transition-colors ${
197        isLight ? 'bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-900' : 'bg-[#09090b] border-[#18181b] text-white'
198      }`}>
199        {saveError && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-red-500">{saveError}</p>}
200        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
201          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-500 font-display font-bold">
202            <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0" />
203            <span>Save Call Disposition</span>
204          </div>
205          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
206            <span className={`text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 ${
207              timeLeft <= 10 
208                ? 'bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 border-red-500/30 animate-pulse' 
209                : isLight
210                  ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300'
211                  : 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20'
212            }`}>
213              <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
214              <span>{timeLeft}s</span>
215            </span>
216            <button
217              onClick={handleClose}
218              disabled={saving}
219              className={`p-1 rounded-lg border transition cursor-pointer ${
220                isLight ? 'border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-500' : 'border-[#27272a] hover:bg-[#18181b] text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
221              }`}
222              title="Close (Esc)"
223            >
224              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
225            </button>
226          </div>
227        </div>
228        <div className="space-y-1">
229          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 font-mono">Log final calling outcome for lead:</p>
230          <p className={`text-sm font-bold uppercase ${isLight ? 'text-slate-900' : 'text-white'}`}>{leadName}</p>
231        </div>
232
233        <div className="space-y-3">
234          <div className="space-y-1">
235            <label className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 uppercase font-bold">Call Outcome</label>
236            <select
237              value={outcome}
238              onChange={(e) => setOutcome(e.target.value)}
239              className={`w-full border focus:border-amber-500 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold focus:outline-none transition cursor-pointer ${
240                isLight ? 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-900' : 'bg-[#121215] border-[#27272a] text-white'
241              }`}
242            >
243              <option value="ANSWERED">Answered & Spoke</option>
244              <option value="INTERESTED">Interested Lead</option>
245              <option value="NOT_INTERESTED">Not Interested</option>
246              <option value="NO_ANSWER">No Answer / Missed</option>
247              <option value="BUSY">Line Busy / Dropped</option>
248              <option value="FAILED">Carrier Failed (Insufficient Balance / Unreachable)</option>
249              <option value="CALLBACK_REQUESTED">Callback Requested</option>
250              <option value="WRONG_NUMBER">Wrong Number</option>
251            </select>
252          </div>
253
254          <div className="space-y-1">
255            <label className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 uppercase font-bold">Disposition Notes</label>
256            <textarea
257              value={notes}
258              onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
259              placeholder="Add optional notes..."
260              rows={3}
261              className={`w-full border focus:border-amber-500 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs font-mono focus:outline-none transition ${
262                isLight ? 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-900' : 'bg-[#121215] border-[#27272a] text-white'
263              }`}
264            />
265          </div>
266        </div>
267
268        <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2 font-mono">
269          <button
270            onClick={handleClose}
271            disabled={saving}
272            className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl border transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 ${
273              isLight ? 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 border-slate-200 text-slate-700' : 'bg-[#18181b] border-[#27272a] text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
274            }`}
275          >
276            Cancel
277          </button>
278          <button
279            onClick={handleSave}
280            disabled={saving}
281            className="flex-1 py-2 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-black font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
282          >
283            {saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Log'}
284          </button>
285        </div>
286      </div>
287    </div>
288  );
289};

1import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';2import { RefreshCw, AlertCircle, Download } from 'lucide-react';3import type { CallLog as CallLogType } from '../types';45interface CallLogProps {6  serverUrl: string;7  authToken?: string | null;8  isLight?: boolean;9}1011export const CallLog: React.FC<CallLogProps> = ({ serverUrl, authToken, isLight }) => {12  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<CallLogType[]>([]);13  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);14  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);15  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);1617  const fetchLogs = async () => {18    setLoading(true);19    setError(null);20    try {21      const headers: Record<string, string> = {};22      if (authToken) {23        headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${authToken}`;24      }25      const res = await fetch(`${serverUrl}/logs`, { headers });26      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load call log history.');27      const data = await res.json();28      // sort logs by timestamp descending29      data.sort((a: CallLogType, b: CallLogType) =>30        new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - 1import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
2import { io, Socket } from 'socket.io-client';
3
4export function useSocket(serverUrl: string = 'http://localhost:5000', authToken?: string) {
5  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);
6  const [sessionId, setSessionId] = useState<string | null>(null);
7  const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
8  const [qrPayload, setQrPayload] = useState<any>(null);
9  const [phoneConnected, setPhoneConnected] = useState(false);
10  const [phoneDeviceName, setPhoneDeviceName] = useState<string | null>(null);
11  const [phoneBtAddress, setPhoneBtAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);
12  const [phoneOsType, setPhoneOsType] = useState<string | null>(null);
13  const [phoneIpAddress, setPhoneIpAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);
14  const [phoneDeviceId, setPhoneDeviceId] = useState<string | null>(null);
15  const [laptopBtAddress, setLaptopBtAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);
16  const [callState, setCallState] = useState<'IDLE' | 'CALLING' | 'ACTIVE'>('IDLE');
17  const [granularCallState, setGranularCallState] = useState<string>('IDLE');
18  const [callSessionData, setCallSessionData] = useState<{
19    callId?: string;
20    state?: string;
21    phone?: string;
22    name?: string;
23    leadId?: string;
24    commandId?: string;
25    reason?: string;
26    duration?: number;
27    timestamp?: string;
28  } | null>(null);
29  const [lastCallFinished, setLastCallFinished] = useState<{ reason: string; duration: number } | null>(null);
30  const [lastBlockedReason, setLastBlockedReason] = useState<{ reason: string; message: string } | null>(null);
31  const [deviceError, setDeviceError] = useState<string | null>(null);
32  const [latencyMs, setLatencyMs] = useState<number | null>(null);
33  const [incomingCall, setIncomingCall] = useState<{ phone: string; deviceName: string; timestamp: string } | null>(null);
34  const [availableSims, setAvailableSims] = useState<any[]>([]);
35  const [selectedSimSlot, setSelectedSimSlot] = useState<number | null>(null);
36
37  const socketRef = useRef<Socket | null>(null);
38  const activeCallIdRef = useRef<string | undefined>(undefined);
39
40  // Standalone heartbeat ping effect
41  useEffect(() => {
42    if (!isConnected || !sessionId || !phoneConnected || !socketRef.current) {
43      setLatencyMs(null);
44      return;
45    }
46
47    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
48      if (socketRef.current) {
49        socketRef.current.emit('client:ping', { sessionId, timestamp: Date.now() });
50      }
51    }, 3000);
52
53    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
54  }, [isConnected, sessionId, phoneConnected]);
55
56  useEffect(() => {
57    if (!authToken) {
58      socketRef.current = null;
59      setIsConnected(false);
60      setPhoneConnected(false);
61      setSessionId(null);
62      setCallState('IDLE');
63      setCallSessionData(null);
64      setLastCallFinished(null);
65      activeCallIdRef.current = undefined;
66      return;
67    }
68    const socket = io(serverUrl, {
69      transports: ['websocket', 'polling'],
70      reconnectionAttempts: 5,
71      reconnectionDelay: 1000,
72      auth: authToken ? { token: authToken } : {}
73    });
74
75    socketRef.current = socket;
76
77    socket.on('connect', () => {
78      setIsConnected(true);
79      const prevSessionId = localStorage.getItem('octal_session_id');
80      socket.emit('laptop:register', {
81        previousSessionId: prevSessionId || undefined,
82        authToken: authToken || undefined
83      });
84    });
85
86    const markDisconnected = () => {
87      setIsConnected(false);
88      setPhoneConnected(false);
89      setGranularCallState('RECOVERY_REQUIRED');
90      socket.sendBuffer = [];
91    };
92    socket.on('disconnect', markDisconnected);
93    socket.on('connect_error', markDisconnected);
94
95    socket.on('session:created', (data: {
96      sessionId: string;
97      token: string;
98      laptopBtAddress: string;
99      qrPayload: any;
100    }) => {
101      activeCallIdRef.current = undefined;
102      setCallState('IDLE');
103      setGranularCallState('IDLE');
104      setCallSessionData(null);
105      setSessionId(data.sessionId);
106      setToken(data.token);
107      setLaptopBtAddress(data.laptopBtAddress);
108      setQrPayload(data.qrPayload);
109      localStorage.setItem('octal_session_id', data.sessionId);
110    });
111
112    socket.on('session:refreshed', (data: {
113      token: string;
114      qrPayload: any;
115    }) => {
116      setToken(data.token);
117      setQrPayload(data.qrPayload);
118    });
119
120    socket.on('phone:connected', (data: {
121      deviceName: string;
122      phoneBtAddress: string;
123      phoneOsType: string;
124      phoneIpAddress: string;
125      deviceId?: string;
126      sims?: any[];
127      selectedSimSlot?: number;
128    }) => {
129      setPhoneConnected(true);
130      setPhoneDeviceName(data.deviceName);
131      setPhoneBtAddress(data.phoneBtAddress);
132      setPhoneOsType(data.phoneOsType);
133      setPhoneIpAddress(data.phoneIpAddress);
134      if (data.deviceId) setPhoneDeviceId(data.deviceId);
135      if (data.sims && Array.isArray(data.sims)) setAvailableSims(data.sims);
136      if (data.selectedSimSlot !== undefined) setSelectedSimSlot(data.selectedSimSlot);
137    });
138
139    socket.on('device:sim-info', (data: { sims?: any[]; selectedSimSlot?: number }) => {
140      if (data.sims && Array.isArray(data.sims)) setAvailableSims(data.sims);
141      if (data.selectedSimSlot !== undefined) setSelectedSimSlot(data.selectedSimSlot);
142    });
143
144    socket.on('phone:disconnected', () => {
145      setPhoneConnected(false);
146      setPhoneDeviceName(null);
147      setPhoneBtAddress(null);
148      setPhoneOsType(null);
149      setPhoneIpAddress(null);
150      setPhoneDeviceId(null);
151      setAvailableSims([]);
152      setSelectedSimSlot(null);
153      setCallState('IDLE');
154      setGranularCallState('IDLE');
155      setCallSessionData(null);
156    });
157
158    socket.on('device:error', (data: { error: string }) => {
159      setDeviceError(data.error);
160      setTimeout(() => setDeviceError(null), 6000);
161    });
162
163    socket.on('error', (err: any) => {
164      setDeviceError(err?.message || 'Connection or command failed.');
165      console.warn('[Socket Error]:', err);
166    });
167
168    socket.on('call:started', () => {
169      setCallState('ACTIVE');
170      setGranularCallState('ACTIVE');
171      setIncomingCall(null);
172    });
173
174    socket.on('call:status-changed', (data: {
175      callId?: string;
176      state: string;
177      phone?: string;
178      name?: string;
179      leadId?: string;
180      commandId?: string;
181      reason?: string;
182      duration?: number;
183      timestamp?: string;
184    }) => {
185      if (data.callId && activeCallIdRef.current && data.callId !== activeCallIdRef.current && data.state !== 'COMMAND_SENT') return;
186      if (data.callId) activeCallIdRef.current = data.callId;
187      setGranularCallState(data.state);
188      setCallSessionData(data);
189      if (['COMMAND_SENT', 'COMMAND_RECEIVED', 'DIALING', 'RINGING'].includes(data.state)) {
190        setCallState('CALLING');
191      } else if (data.state === 'ACTIVE') {
192        setCallState('ACTIVE');
193        setIncomingCall(null);
194      } else if (['ENDED', 'DIAL_FAILED', 'BUSY', 'NO_ANSWER', 'LOCAL_HANGUP', 'REMOTE_HANGUP', 'IDLE'].includes(data.state)) {
195        setCallState('IDLE');
196      }
197    });
198
199    socket.on('call:incoming', (data: { phone: string; deviceName: string; timestamp: string }) => {
200      setIncomingCall(data);
201    });
202
203    socket.on('call:incoming-dismissed', () => {
204      setIncomingCall(null);
205    });
206
207    socket.on('call:finished', (data: { reason: string; duration: number; leadId?: string; commandId?: string; callId?: string }) => {
208      if (data.callId && activeCallIdRef.current && data.callId !== activeCallIdRef.current) return;
209      setCallState('IDLE');
210      setGranularCallState('ENDED');
211      setIncomingCall(null);
212      setLastCallFinished(data);
213    });
214
215    socket.on('dial:blocked', (data: { reason: string; message: string }) => {
216      setCallState('IDLE');
217      setGranularCallState('IDLE');
218      setLastBlockedReason(data);
219      console.warn('[SafetyController] Call blocked:', data.reason, data.message);
220    });
221
222    socket.on('campaign:emergency_stopped', () => {
223      setCallState('IDLE');
224      setGranularCallState('IDLE');
225    });
226
227    socket.on('client:pong', (data: { timestamp: number }) => {
228      const diff = Date.now() - data.timestamp;
229      setLatencyMs(diff);
230    });
231
232    socket.on('session:ended', () => {
233      setSessionId(null);
234      setToken(null);
235      setLaptopBtAddress(null);
236      setQrPayload(null);
237      setPhoneConnected(false);
238      setPhoneDeviceName(null);
239      setPhoneBtAddress(null);
240      setPhoneOsType(null);
241      setPhoneIpAddress(null);
242      setPhoneDeviceId(null);
243      setCallState('IDLE');
244      setGranularCallState('IDLE');
245      setCallSessionData(null);
246      localStorage.removeItem('octal_session_id');
247    });
248
249    socket.on('error', (err: any) => {
250      console.error('[Socket Error]', err);
251    });
252
253    return () => {
254      socket.sendBuffer = [];
255      socket.removeAllListeners();
256      socket.disconnect();
257      if (socketRef.current === socket) socketRef.current = null;
258    };
259  }, [serverUrl, authToken]);
260
261  const revokePhone = () => {
262    if (socketRef.current?.connected && sessionId) {
263      socketRef.current.emit('laptop:revoke-phone', { sessionId });
264      setPhoneConnected(false);
265      setPhoneDeviceName(null);
266      setPhoneBtAddress(null);
267      setPhoneOsType(null);
268      setPhoneIpAddress(null);
269      setPhoneDeviceId(null);
270    }
271  };
272
273  const connectDevice = (deviceId: string) => {
274    if (socketRef.current && sessionId) {
275      setDeviceError(null);
276      socketRef.current.emit('laptop:connect-device', { sessionId, deviceId });
277    }
278  };
279
280  const disconnectDevice = (deviceId?: string) => {
281    if (socketRef.current && sessionId) {
282      socketRef.current.emit('laptop:disconnect-device', { sessionId, deviceId });
283      setPhoneConnected(false);
284      setPhoneDeviceName(null);
285      setPhoneBtAddress(null);
286      setPhoneOsType(null);
287      setPhoneIpAddress(null);
288      setPhoneDeviceId(null);
289    }
290  };
291
292  const dialLead = (
293    phone: string,
294    name: string,
295    timeout: number = 30,
296    leadId?: string,
297    campaignId?: string,
298    options?: { forceRedial?: boolean; simSlot?: number | null }
299  ) => {
300    if (socketRef.current && sessionId) {
301      if (!phoneConnected || callState !== 'IDLE') return;
302      activeCallIdRef.current = undefined;
303      setCallState('CALLING');
304      setGranularCallState('COMMAND_SENT');
305      setLastBlockedReason(null);
306      const chosenSlot = options?.simSlot !== undefined ? options.simSlot : selectedSimSlot;
307      socketRef.current.emit('dial:lead', {
308        sessionId,
309        phone,
310        name,
311        timeout,
312        leadId,
313        campaignId,
314        forceRedial: options?.forceRedial,
315        simSlot: chosenSlot !== null ? chosenSlot : undefined
316      });
317    }
318  };
319
320  const hangupCall = () => {
321    if (socketRef.current && sessionId) {
322      socketRef.current.emit('dial:hangup', { sessionId, callId: activeCallIdRef.current });
323      setIncomingCall(null);
324    }
325  };
326
327  const answerCall = () => {
328    if (socketRef.current && sessionId) {
329      socketRef.current.emit('dial:answer', { sessionId });
330      setIncomingCall(null);
331    }
332  };
333
334  const emergencyStop = () => {
335    if (socketRef.current && sessionId) {
336      socketRef.current.emit('campaign:emergency_stop', { sessionId });
337    }
338  };
339
340  const clearEmergencyStop = () => {
341    if (socketRef.current) {
342      socketRef.current.emit('campaign:clear_emergency_stop');
343    }
344  };
345
346  return {
347    isConnected,
348    sessionId,
349    token,
350    qrPayload,
351    phoneConnected,
352    phoneDeviceName,
353    phoneBtAddress,
354    phoneOsType,
355    phoneIpAddress,
356    phoneDeviceId,
357    laptopBtAddress,
358    callState,
359    granularCallState,
360    callSessionData,
361    incomingCall,
362    lastCallFinished,
363    lastBlockedReason,
364    deviceError,
365    latencyMs,
366    availableSims,
367    selectedSimSlot,
368    setSelectedSimSlot,
369    revokePhone,
370    connectDevice,
371    disconnectDevice,
372    dialLead,
373    answerCall,
374    hangupCall,
375    emergencyStop,
376    clearEmergencyStop,
377    socket: socketRef.current
378  };
379}
