1import 'dart:async';
2import 'dart:math' as math;
3import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
4import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
5import 'package:socket_io_client/socket_io_client.dart' as io;
6import '../widgets/octal_logo.dart';
7import '../services/telecom_service.dart';
8import '../services/call_outbox_service.dart';
9import '../services/phone_bridge_service.dart';
10
11class CallingScreen extends StatefulWidget {
12  final String phone;
13  final String name;
14  final String leadId;
15  final String? commandId;
16  final String? callId;
17  final int timeout;
18  final io.Socket socket;
19  final String sessionId;
20  final int? simSlot;
21  final VoidCallback? onCallEnded;
22
23  const CallingScreen({
24    super.key,
25    required this.phone,
26    required this.name,
27    required this.leadId,
28    this.commandId,
29    this.callId,
30    this.simSlot,
31    required this.timeout,
32    required this.socket,
33    required this.sessionId,
34    this.onCallEnded,
35  });
36
37  @override
38  State<CallingScreen> createState() => _CallingScreenState();
39}
40
41enum CallPhase { ringing, connected, ended }
42
43class _CallingScreenState extends State<CallingScreen> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
44  // ignore: prefer_final_fields
45  String _callStatus = '00:00';
46  int _secondsLeft = 30;
47  int _talkSeconds = 0;
48  Timer? _ringingTimer;
49  Timer? _talkTimer;
50  StreamSubscription<TelecomCallEvent>? _telecomSub;
51  CallPhase _phase = CallPhase.ringing;
52  bool _callEnded = false;
53  bool _cancelRequested = false;
54  bool _hasEmittedPickedUp = false;
55  bool _isMuted = false;
56  bool _isSpeaker = false;
57
58  late AnimationController _waveAnimController;
59
60  @override
61  void initState() {
62    super.initState();
63    _secondsLeft = widget.timeout > 0 ? widget.timeout : 30;
64
65
66    _waveAnimController = AnimationController(
67      vsync: this,
68      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1200),
69    )..repeat(reverse: true);
70
71    // 1. Send explicit command acknowledgement to backend
72    widget.socket.emit('phone:dial-ack', {
73      'commandId': widget.commandId,
74      'callId': widget.callId,
75      'accepted': true,
76    });
77
78    // Mark Auto Dialer call active to prevent duplicate InCallScreen overlay
79    TelecomService.instance.isAutoDialerCallActive = true;
80
81    // Register Telecom call event listener (primary source of truth for GSM calls)
82    _telecomSub = TelecomService.instance.callEvents.listen((event) {
83      if (!mounted || _callEnded) return;
84
85      // Uncorrelated event guard: If event specifies a callId and our widget has a callId, and they don't match, ignore it.
86      // This prevents call waiting or foreign calls from terminating the active campaign call.
87      if (event.callId.isNotEmpty && widget.callId != null && widget.callId!.isNotEmpty && event.callId != widget.callId) {
88        debugPrint('CallingScreen: Ignored event for different callId ${event.callId} (current: ${widget.callId})');
89        return;
90      }
91
92      if (event.type == 'state_changed') {
93        final st = event.state.toUpperCase();
94        debugPrint('CallingScreen: Telecom state_changed -> $st');
95        if (st == 'ACTIVE') {
96          if (_phase != CallPhase.connected) {
97            setState(() {
98              _phase = CallPhase.connected;
99            });
100            _startTalkTimer();
101          }
102          if (!_hasEmittedPickedUp) {
103            _hasEmittedPickedUp = true;
104            debugPrint('CallingScreen: Emitting call:picked-up to sync ACTIVE state with server & web');
105            widget.socket.emit('call:picked-up', {
106              'callId': widget.callId,
107              'sessionId': widget.sessionId,
108            });
109          }
110        } else if (st == 'RINGING' || st == 'DIALING') {
111          widget.socket.emit('call:state-changed', {
112            'callId': widget.callId,
113            'commandId': widget.commandId,
114            'state': 'RINGING',
115          });
116        }
117      } else if (event.type == 'removed') {
118        final int dur = (event.duration != null && event.duration! > 0) ? event.duration! : _talkSeconds;
119        // Authoritative: Native ACTIVE transition is evidence of an answered call. No 10-second heuristic.
120        final bool answered = _hasEmittedPickedUp || _phase == CallPhase.connected || event.reason == 'ANSWERED' || (event.answered == true);
121        final String reason = answered ? 'ANSWERED' : (dur > 0 && event.reason != 'CANCELLED' ? 'COMPLETED' : (event.reason ?? 'NO_ANSWER'));
122        _endCall(
123          reason: reason,
124          duration: dur,
125          answered: answered,
126        );
127      } else if (event.type == 'legacy_state') {
128        // Legacy telephony state from TelephonyManager (routed through TelecomService)
129        if (mounted) {
130          _handleCallStateChange(event.state);
131        }
132      } else if (event.type == 'legacy_ended') {
133        // Legacy call ended event (routed through TelecomService)
134        if (mounted) {
135          final bool answered = _hasEmittedPickedUp || _phase == CallPhase.connected || event.answered == true || event.reason == 'ANSWERED';
136          _endCall(
137            reason: answered ? 'ANSWERED' : (event.reason ?? 'NO_ANSWER'),
138            duration: event.duration ?? _talkSeconds,
139            answered: answered,
140          );
141        }
142      }
143    });
144
145    // Start Foreground Service so Android 14 doesn't freeze app during call
146    _nativeChannel.invokeMethod('startForegroundService', {
147      'status': 'Calling ${widget.name.isNotEmpty ? widget.name : widget.phone}...'
148    }).catchError((_) {});
149
150    // Listen for remote hangup commands using named reference to avoid stripping service handlers
151    widget.socket.on('phone:hangup', _onRemoteHangup);
152    widget.socket.on('phone:hangup-call', _onRemoteHangup);
153
154    _placeGsmCall();
155  }
156
157  void _onRemoteHangup(dynamic _) => _handleRemoteHangup();
158
159  void _startTalkTimer() {
160    _ringingTimer?.cancel();
161    _talkTimer?.cancel();
162    _talkSeconds = 0;
163    _talkTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
164      if (mounted) {
165        setState(() {
166          _talkSeconds++;
167          final m = (_talkSeconds ~/ 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0');
168          final s = (_talkSeconds % 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0');
169          _callStatus = '$m:$s';
170        });
171      }
172    });
173  }
174
175  void _handleRemoteHangup() {
176    _cancelRequested = true;
177    debugPrint('CallingScreen: Received remote hangup command');
178    TelecomService.instance.disconnect(callId: widget.callId).catchError((_) => false);
179    _nativeChannel.invokeMethod('endCall').catchError((e) {
180      debugPrint('CallingScreen: Native endCall ignored: $e');
181    });
182    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1500), () {
183      if (mounted && !_callEnded) {
184        _endCall(reason: 'CANCELLED', duration: 0, answered: false);
185      }
186    });
187  }
188
189  void _handleCallStateChange(String state) {
190    debugPrint("CallingScreen: Native GSM state -> $state");
191    if (state == 'OFFHOOK') {
192      // Physical limitation: Android enters CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK as soon as dialing starts on the GSM radio.
193      // OFFHOOK does NOT indicate a remote human answered.
194      // Remain in non-confirmed RINGING state. DO NOT emit call:picked-up.
195      widget.socket.emit('call:state-changed', {
196        'callId': widget.callId,
197        'commandId': widget.commandId,
198        'state': 'RINGING',
199      });
200    } else if (state == 'IDLE') {
201      // Cellular radio returned to IDLE. Native layer correlates CallLog and emits onCallEnded.
202      // Bounded safety fallback in case native thread takes longer than expected:
203      Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 3500), () {
204        if (mounted && !_callEnded) {
205          _endCall(reason: 'NO_ANSWER', duration: 0, answered: false);
206        }
207      });
208    }
209  }
210
211  void _startRingingTimer() {
212    _ringingTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
213      if (mounted) {
214        setState(() {
215          _secondsLeft--;
216          if (_secondsLeft <= 0) {
217            timer.cancel();
218            _cancelRequested = true;
219            _nativeChannel.invokeMethod('endCall').catchError((_) {});
220            Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 2000), () {
221              if (mounted && !_callEnded) {
222                _endCall(reason: 'NO_ANSWER', duration: 0, answered: false);
223              }
224            });
225          }
226        });
227      }
228    });
229  }
230
231  static const MethodChannel _nativeChannel = MethodChannel('com.octal.dialer/call');
232
233  Future<void> _placeGsmCall() async {
234    final cleanPhone = widget.phone.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^\d+]'), '');
235    if (cleanPhone.isEmpty) {
236      _endCall(reason: 'INVALID_PHONE');
237      return;
238    }
239
240    try {
241      // 1. Centralized Prerequisite Gate: Default Dialer role + Mandatory Permissions
242      final bool prereqsPassed = await TelecomService.instance.ensureCallingPrerequisites();
243      if (!mounted || _callEnded || _cancelRequested) return;
244      if (!prereqsPassed) {
245        debugPrint('CallingScreen: Prerequisites not met (Default Dialer role or permissions denied).');
246        _endCall(reason: 'PREREQUISITES_DENIED');
247        return;
248      }
249
250      // 2. Direct Telecom call placement via TelecomManager.placeCall()
251      final bool placed = await TelecomService.instance.placeCall(
252        cleanPhone,
253        simSlot: widget.simSlot,
254        callId: widget.callId,
255      );
256
257      if (!mounted || _callEnded || _cancelRequested) return;
258      if (!placed) {
259        debugPrint('CallingScreen: Telecom placeCall returned false.');
260        _endCall(reason: 'CALL_PLACE_FAILED');
261        return;
262      }
263
264      _startRingingTimer();
265      widget.socket.emit('call:state-changed', {
266        'callId': widget.callId,
267        'commandId': widget.commandId,
268        'state': 'DIALING',
269      });
270    } catch (e) {
271      debugPrint('Direct GSM call failed: $e');
272      _endCall(reason: 'CALL_FAILED');
273    }
274  }
275
276  void _endCall({required String reason, int duration = 0, bool answered = false}) {
277    if (_callEnded) return; // Guard against duplicate terminal events
278    _callEnded = true;
279    _phase = CallPhase.ended;
280    _ringingTimer?.cancel();
281    _talkTimer?.cancel();
282
283    try {
284      widget.onCallEnded?.call();
285    } catch (_) {}
286
287    final effectiveDuration = duration > 0 ? duration : _talkSeconds;
288    final effectiveAnswered = answered || reason == 'ANSWERED' || _hasEmittedPickedUp || _phase == CallPhase.connected;
289    final effectiveReason = effectiveAnswered ? 'ANSWERED' : reason;
290    final effectiveCallId = widget.callId ?? widget.commandId ?? 'call_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}';
291    PhoneBridgeService.instance.markCallEnqueued(effectiveCallId);
292
293    final outboxEntry = CallOutboxEntry(
294      outboxId: 'ob_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_$effectiveCallId',
295      callId: effectiveCallId,
296      sessionId: widget.sessionId,
297      leadId: widget.leadId.isNotEmpty ? widget.leadId : null,
298      commandId: widget.commandId,
299      phone: widget.phone,
300      name: widget.name,
301      reason: effectiveReason,
302      duration: effectiveDuration,
303      answered: effectiveAnswered,
304      createdAtMs: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
305      serverOrigin: PhoneBridgeService.instance.serverUri,
306      tenantId: PhoneBridgeService.instance.tenantId.isNotEmpty ? PhoneBridgeService.instance.tenantId : null,
307      deviceId: PhoneBridgeService.instance.deviceId.isNotEmpty ? PhoneBridgeService.instance.deviceId : null,
308    );
309
310    // Persist to durable handset outbox BEFORE emitting
311    CallOutboxService.instance.enqueueOutcome(outboxEntry).then((_) {
312      CallOutboxService.instance.flush(
313        widget.socket,
314        currentOrigin: PhoneBridgeService.instance.serverUri,
315        currentTenantId: PhoneBridgeService.instance.tenantId.isNotEmpty ? PhoneBridgeService.instance.tenantId : null,
316        currentDeviceId: PhoneBridgeService.instance.deviceId.isNotEmpty ? PhoneBridgeService.instance.deviceId : null,
317      );
318    }).catchError((err) {
319      debugPrint('[CallingScreen] Outbox enqueue failed: $err. Surface failure and schedule retry without unjournaled bypass.');
320      // Persist failure is retained visibly; outbox service periodic retry will re-attempt persistence
321    });
322
323    try {
324      _nativeChannel.invokeMethod('updateServiceStatus', {
325        'status': 'Call ended. Phone Link active.'
326      });
327      _nativeChannel.invokeMethod('bringToForeground');
328    } catch (_) {}
329
330    if (mounted) {
331      Navigator.pop(context);
332    }
333  }
334
335  @override
336  void dispose() {
337    _waveAnimController.dispose();
338    _ringingTimer?.cancel();
339    _talkTimer?.cancel();
340    _telecomSub?.cancel();
341    widget.socket.off('phone:hangup', _onRemoteHangup);
342    widget.socket.off('phone:hangup-call', _onRemoteHangup);
343    // Clear auto dialer active flag so normal in-call UI operates
344    TelecomService.instance.isAutoDialerCallActive = false;
345    // Defensively ensure TelecomService handler is active
346    TelecomService.instance.reinitialize();
347    super.dispose();
348  }

30  Future<void> _checkSavedConnection() async {
31    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
32    final savedUri = prefs.getString('connection_uri');
33    if (savedUri != null && savedUri.isNotEmpty) {
34      if (savedUri.contains('localhost') || savedUri.contains('127.0.0.1') || savedUri.contains('10.0.2.2')) {
35        await prefs.remove('connection_uri');
36        return;
37      }
38      _uriController.text = savedUri;
39      _connect(savedUri, autoConnect: true);
40    }
41  }

43  Future<void> _connect(String uri, {bool autoConnect = false}) async {
44    setState(() {
45      _isLoading = true;
46      _errorMessage = '';
47    });
48
49    try {
50      final parsed = Uri.parse(uri);
51
52      String? sessionId = parsed.queryParameters['sessionId'];
53      String? token = parsed.queryParameters['token'];
54      String? rawServerUrl = parsed.queryParameters['serverUrl'];
55      String laptopName = parsed.queryParameters['laptop'] ?? 'Laptop Host';
56      String laptopBtAddress = parsed.queryParameters['bt'] ?? '';
57
58      String effectiveServerUrl;
59      if (rawServerUrl != null && rawServerUrl.isNotEmpty) {
60        final sanitized = AppConfig.sanitizeUrl(rawServerUrl);
61        effectiveServerUrl = sanitized ?? AppConfig.apiBaseUrl;
62      } else if ((parsed.scheme == 'http' || parsed.scheme == 'https') && parsed.host.isNotEmpty) {
63        final portStr = parsed.hasPort ? ':${parsed.port}' : (parsed.scheme == 'https' ? '' : ':3000');
64        effectiveServerUrl = '${parsed.scheme}://${parsed.host}$portStr';
65      } else {
66        effectiveServerUrl = AppConfig.apiBaseUrl;
67      }
68
69      if (sessionId == null || sessionId.isEmpty || token == null || token.isEmpty) {
70        throw const FormatException('Missing required pairing parameters (sessionId/token) in QR payload');
71      }
72
73      final serverUri = Uri.parse(effectiveServerUrl);
74      if (!['http', 'https'].contains(serverUri.scheme)) {
75        throw const FormatException('Invalid server URL scheme (must be http/https)');
76      }
77      if (serverUri.host.isEmpty) {
78        throw const FormatException('Invalid server URL (empty host)');
79      }
80
81      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
82      await prefs.setString('connection_uri', uri);
83
84      if (mounted) {
85        Navigator.pushReplacement(
86          context,
87          MaterialPageRoute(
88            builder: (context) => ConnectedScreen(
89              sessionId: sessionId,
90              token: token,
91              serverUrl: effectiveServerUrl,
92              laptopName: laptopName,
93              laptopBtAddress: laptopBtAddress,
94            ),
95          ),
96        );
97      }
98    } catch (e) {
99      setState(() {
100        _errorMessage = e.toString().replaceFirst('Exception: ', '');
101      });
102      if (autoConnect) {
103        final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
104        await prefs.remove('connection_uri');
105      }
106    } finally {
107      if (mounted) {
108        setState(() {
109          _isLoading = false;
110        });
111      }
112    }
113  }

115  Future<void> _pasteClipboard() async {

38class _ConnectedScreenState extends State<ConnectedScreen> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
39  io.Socket? _socket;
40  bool _isConnected = false;
41  int _selectedTabIndex = 0;
42  final List<String> _logs = [];
43  Timer? _pingTimer;
44  Timer? _connectionTimeoutTimer;
45
46  late String _deviceBtAddress;
47  late String _deviceName;
48  bool _isInCall = false;
49
50  static const MethodChannel _nativeChannel = MethodChannel('com.octal.dialer/call');
51
52  @override
53  void initState() {
54    super.initState();
55    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
56
57    // Initial placeholder values before the async call completes
58    _deviceName = 'Android Device';
59    _deviceBtAddress = '';
60
61    _initDeviceCredentials().then((_) {
62      _initSocket();
63    });
64  }
65
66  @override
67  void dispose() {
68    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
69    _connectionTimeoutTimer?.cancel();
70    _pingTimer?.cancel();
71    super.dispose();
72  }
73
74  @override
75  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
76    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) {
77      // App came back to foreground — verify socket connection
78      if (_socket != null && !_socket!.connected) {
79        _socket!.connect();
80      }
81    }
82  }
83
84  Future<void> _initDeviceCredentials() async {
85    String modelName = 'Android Device';
86    if (Platform.isAndroid) {
87      try {
88        final Map? info = await _nativeChannel.invokeMethod('getDeviceInfo');
89        if (info != null) {
90          final manufacturer = (info['manufacturer'] ?? '').toString().trim();
91          final model = (info['model'] ?? '').toString().trim();
92
93          if (manufacturer.length > 256 || model.length > 256) {
94            throw Exception('Invalid device info length');
95          }
96          if (manufacturer.contains('\n') || model.contains('\n')) {
97            throw Exception('Invalid device info format');
98          }
99
100          modelName = '$manufacturer $model'.trim();
101          if (modelName.isEmpty) modelName = 'Android Device';
102        }
103      } catch (_) {}
104    } else if (Platform.isIOS) {
105      modelName = 'iPhone';
106    }
107
108    _deviceName = modelName;
109
110    final host = _deviceName;
111    int hash = 0;
112    for (int i = 0; i < host.length; i++) {
113      hash = host.codeUnitAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
114    }
115    final mac = ['48', 'D2', '24', 'D3'];
116    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
117      final byte = ((hash >> (i * 8)) & 0xFF).toRadixString(16).toUpperCase().padLeft(2, '0');
118      mac.add(byte);
119    }
120    _deviceBtAddress = mac.join(':');
121
122    if (mounted) {
123      setState(() {});
124    }
125  }
126
127  void _addLog(String log) {
128    if (mounted) {
129      setState(() {
130        final timeStr = DateTime.now().toLocal().toString().split(' ')[1].substring(0, 8);
131        _logs.add('[$timeStr] $log');
132        if (_logs.length > 30) {
133          _logs.removeAt(0);
134        }
135      });
136    }
137  }
138
139  void _initSocket() async {
140    final effectiveUrl = AppConfig.sanitizeUrl(widget.serverUrl) ?? AppConfig.apiBaseUrl;
141    _addLog('[System] Connecting to Octal Bridge: $effectiveUrl');
142
143    if (PhoneBridgeService.instance.serverUrl != effectiveUrl ||
144        PhoneBridgeService.instance.socket == null ||
145        !PhoneBridgeService.instance.socket!.connected) {
146      await PhoneBridgeService.instance.connectTo(effectiveUrl);
147    }
148    _socket = PhoneBridgeService.instance.socket;
149
150    _attachSocketListeners();
151
152    void emitJoin() {
153      if (_socket != null && _socket!.connected) {
154        _addLog('[Bridge] Pairing with session ${widget.sessionId}...');
155        _socket!.emit('phone:join', {
156          'sessionId': widget.sessionId,
157          'token': widget.token,
158          'deviceName': _deviceName,
159          'deviceId': PhoneBridgeService.instance.deviceId,
160          'phoneOsType': Platform.isAndroid ? 'Android' : 'iOS',
161          'phoneBtAddress': _deviceBtAddress,
162          'authToken': PhoneBridgeService.instance.authToken,
163        });
164      }
165    }
166
167    if (_socket != null && _socket!.connected) {
168      emitJoin();
169    } else {
170      _socket?.onConnect((_) {
171        emitJoin();
172      });
173    }
174
175    // Guard: 15-second connection timeout -> automatically return to QR scanner if not connected
176    _connectionTimeoutTimer?.cancel();
177    _connectionTimeoutTimer = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 15), () {
178      if (mounted && !_isConnected) {
179        _addLog('[Bridge] Connection timeout. Returning to QR scanner...');
180        _autoReturnToScanner(message: 'Connection timed out. Please scan QR code again.');
181      }
182    });
183
184    _startHeartbeat();
185    _checkOtaUpdate();
186  }
187
188  void _attachSocketListeners() {
189    if (_socket == null) return;
190
191    _socket!.onDisconnect((_) {
192      if (mounted) {
193        setState(() {
194          _isConnected = false;
195        });
196      }
197      _addLog('[Socket] Disconnected from server');
198      _autoReturnToScanner(message: 'Disconnected from laptop. Scan QR to reconnect.');
199    });
200
201    _socket!.onConnectError((err) {
202      _addLog('[Socket] Connect error: $err');
203    });
204
205    void onPairedHandler(dynamic data) {
206      _connectionTimeoutTimer?.cancel();
207      if (mounted) {
208        setState(() {
209          _isConnected = true;
210        });
211      }
212      _addLog('[Bridge] Octal Bridge Channel Active! Ready for calls.');
213      _startHeartbeat();
214      _checkOtaUpdate();
215      _syncSimInfo();
216    }
217
218    _socket!.on('bridge:paired', onPairedHandler);
219    _socket!.on('phone:paired', onPairedHandler);
220
221    _socket!.on('phone:pong', (_) {
222      // Heartbeat acknowledged by laptop server
223    });
224
225    _socket!.on('phone:ping', (data) {
226      final timestamp = data != null ? data['timestamp'] : null;
227      _socket!.emit('phone:pong', {
228        'sessionId': widget.sessionId,
229        'timestamp': timestamp,
230      });
231    });
232
233    _socket!.on('app:update_available', (data) {
234      final String latestVersion = data['latestVersion'] ?? '1.0.1';
235      final String apkUrl = data['apkUrl'] ?? '';
236      final String releaseNotes = data['releaseNotes'] ?? '';
237      _addLog('[OTA Engine] NEW UPDATE DETECTED: v$latestVersion!');
238      _showUpdateDialog(latestVersion, apkUrl, releaseNotes);
239    });
240
241    _socket!.on('app:up_to_date', (data) {
242      _addLog('[OTA Engine] App is on latest release (v${data['version']}).');
243    });
244
245    _socket!.on('phone:kicked', (data) {
246      _addLog('[Bridge] Revoked by host: ${data['reason'] ?? 'None'}');
247      _autoReturnToScanner(message: 'Device revoked by laptop.');
248    });
249
250    _socket!.on('bridge:unpaired', (_) {
251      _addLog('[Bridge] Unpaired by laptop dashboard.');
252      _autoReturnToScanner(message: 'Unpaired by laptop. Scan QR to reconnect.');
253    });
254
255    _socket!.on('session:ended', (_) {
256      _addLog('[Bridge] Session ended by laptop.');
257      _autoReturnToScanner(message: 'Session ended. Scan QR to reconnect.');
258    });
259
260    _socket!.on('phone:dial', (data) {
261      final String phone = data['phone'] ?? '';
262      final String name = data['name'] ?? 'Unknown Lead';
263      final String leadId = data['leadId'] ?? '';
264      final String? commandId = data['commandId'];
265      final String? callId = data['callId'];
266      final int timeout = data['timeout'] ?? 30;
267      final int? simSlot = data['simSlot'] is int
268          ? data['simSlot'] as int
269          : (data['simSlot'] != null ? int.tryParse(data['simSlot'].toString()) : null);
270
271      _addLog('[Bridge] LAPTOP REQUEST CALL -> $name ($phone)');
272
273      // Guard: If already in a call, reject explicitly with dial-ack so backend/laptop doesn't hang!
274      if (_isInCall) {
275        _addLog('[Bridge] Busy: currently in active call — rejecting dial command');
276        _socket?.emit('phone:dial-ack', {
277          'commandId': commandId,
278          'callId': callId,
279          'accepted': false,
280          'reason': 'BUSY_IN_CALL',
281        });
282        return;
283      }
284
285      if (mounted) {
286        _isInCall = true;
287        Navigator.push(
288          context,
289          MaterialPageRoute(
290            builder: (context) => CallingScreen(
291              phone: phone,
292              name: name,
293              leadId: leadId,
294              commandId: commandId,
295              callId: callId,
296              simSlot: simSlot,
297              timeout: timeout,
298              socket: _socket!,
299              sessionId: widget.sessionId,
300              onCallEnded: () {
301                _isInCall = false;
302              },
303            ),
304          ),
305        ).then((_) {
306          _isInCall = false;
307        });
308      }
309    });
310  }
311
312  Future<void> _syncSimInfo() async {
313    try {
314      final res = await _nativeChannel.invokeMethod('getSimInfo');
315      if (res is Map && _socket != null) {
316        _socket!.emit('phone:sim-info', {
317          'sessionId': widget.sessionId,
318          'sims': res['sims'],
319          'selectedSimSlot': res['selectedSimSlot'],
320          'selectedCarrierName': res['selectedCarrierName'],
321        });
322        _addLog('[Bridge] Synced SIM profile to dashboard (${res['sims'] is List ? (res['sims'] as List).length : 0} SIMs)');
323      }
324    } catch (e) {
325      debugPrint('[ConnectedScreen] _syncSimInfo error: $e');
326    }
327  }

485// ─── OTA Update Dialog with in-app download + auto install ────────────────────
486class _OtaUpdateDialog extends StatefulWidget {
487  final String version;
488  final String apkUrl;
489  final String notes;
490  const _OtaUpdateDialog({required this.version, required this.apkUrl, required this.notes});
491
492  @override
493  State<_OtaUpdateDialog> createState() => _OtaUpdateDialogState();
494}
495
496class _OtaUpdateDialogState extends State<_OtaUpdateDialog> {
497  double _progress = 0;
498  int _receivedBytes = 0;
499  int _totalBytes = 0;
500  String _status = 'idle'; // idle | downloading | done | error
501  String _errorMsg = '';
502
503  Future<void> _downloadAndInstall() async {
504    setState(() { _status = 'downloading'; _errorMsg = ''; });
505    http.Client? client;
506    IOSink? sink;
507    try {
508      final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
509      final apkPath = '${dir.path}/OctalDialer_update.apk';
510      final file = File(apkPath);
511
512      int existingLength = 0;
513      if (await file.exists()) {
514        try {
515          existingLength = await file.length();
516        } catch (_) {
517          existingLength = 0;
518        }
519      }
520
521      final request = http.Request('GET', Uri.parse(widget.apkUrl));
522      if (existingLength > 0) {
523        request.headers['Range'] = 'bytes=$existingLength-';
524      }
525
526      client = http.Client();
527      final response = await client.send(request);
528
529      bool isPartial = response.statusCode == 206;
530      int total = (response.contentLength ?? 0) + (isPartial ? existingLength : 0);
531      int received = isPartial ? existingLength : 0;
532
533      if (!isPartial && existingLength > 0 && response.statusCode == 200) {
534        // Server doesn't support range resume — restart clean
535        try { await file.delete(); } catch (_) {}
536        received = 0;
537      }
538
539      sink = file.openWrite(mode: isPartial ? FileMode.append : FileMode.write);
540
541      await response.stream.forEach((chunk) {
542        received += chunk.length;
543        if (mounted) {
544          setState(() {
545            _receivedBytes = received;
546            _totalBytes = total;
547            _progress = total > 0 ? (received / total) : 0;
548          });
549        }
550        sink!.add(chunk);
551      });
552
553      await sink.flush();
554      await sink.close();
555      sink = null;
556
557      if (mounted) {
558        setState(() { _status = 'done'; _progress = 1.0; });
559      }
560
561      if (mounted) {
562        setState(() { _errorMsg = 'APK signature verification not yet implemented. Manual installation required.'; });
563      }
564    } catch (e) {
565      if (sink != null) {
566        try { await sink.close(); } catch (_) {}
567      }
568      if (mounted) {
569        setState(() {
570          _status = 'error';
571          _errorMsg = 'Download interrupted. Tap RETRY to resume (${_formatMb(_receivedBytes)} downloaded).';
572        });
573      }
574    } finally {
575      client?.close();
576    }
577  }

579  String _formatMb(int bytes) {
580    return '${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1)} MB';
581  }
582
583  @override
584  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
585    return AlertDialog(
586      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0F172A),
587      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
588        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
589        side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFFFB800)),
590      ),
591      title: Row(
592        children: [
593          const Icon(Icons.system_update_alt, color: Color(0xFFFFB800)),
594          const SizedBox(width: 8),
595          Expanded(
596            child: Text(
597              'UPDATE v${widget.version} AVAILABLE',
598              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.white),
599            ),
600          ),
601        ],
602      ),
603      content: Column(
604        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
605        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
606        children: [
607          if (widget.notes.isNotEmpty) ...[
608            Text(widget.notes, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: Color(0xFFFFB800), fontFamily: 'monospace')),
609            const SizedBox(height: 12),
610          ],
611          if (_status == 'idle')
612            const Text(
613              'New version ready on your laptop. Tap UPDATE to download and install automatically.',
614              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.white70),
615            ),
616          if (_status == 'downloading') ...[
617            Row(
618              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
619              children: [
620                const Text('Downloading update...', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.white70)),
621                Text(
622                  _totalBytes > 0
623                      ? '${_formatMb(_receivedBytes)} / ${_formatMb(_totalBytes)}'
624                      : _formatMb(_receivedBytes),
625                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: Color(0xFFFFB800), fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
626                ),
627              ],
628            ),
629            const SizedBox(height: 8),
630            LinearProgressIndicator(
631              value: _progress > 0 ? _progress : null,
632              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1E293B),
633              valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Color(0xFFFFB800)),
634              minHeight: 6,
635              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(3),
636            ),
637            const SizedBox(height: 6),
638            Text(
639              '${(_progress * 100).toStringAsFixed(0)}% Completed',
640              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Color(0xFFFFB800), fontFamily: 'monospace'),
641            ),
642          ],
643          if (_status == 'done')
644            const Row(
645              children: [
646                Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Color(0xFF10B981), size: 16),
647                SizedBox(width: 6),
648                Text('Download complete! Opening installer...', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Color(0xFF10B981))),
649              ],
650            ),
651          if (_status == 'error') ...[
652            const Row(
653              children: [
654                Icon(Icons.error_outline, color: Colors.redAccent, size: 16),
655                SizedBox(width: 6),
656                Text('Download failed', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.redAccent)),
657              ],
658            ),
659            const SizedBox(height: 4),
660            Text(_errorMsg, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 9, color: Color(0xFF64748B))),
661          ],
662        ],
663      ),
664      actions: [
665        if (_status == 'idle' || _status == 'error') ...[
666          TextButton(
667            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
668            child: const Text('LATER', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 11)),
669          ),
670          ElevatedButton.icon(
671            onPressed: _downloadAndInstall,
672            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
673              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFFFB800),
674              foregroundColor: Colors.black,
675            ),
676            icon: Icon(_status == 'error' ? Icons.refresh : Icons.download, size: 16),
677            label: Text(_status == 'error' ? 'RETRY' : 'UPDATE NOW',
678                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
679          ),
680        ],
681        if (_status == 'downloading')
682          const Padding(
683            padding: EdgeInsets.all(8.0),
684            child: Text('Please wait...', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 11)),
685          ),
686        if (_status == 'done')
687          TextButton(
688            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
689            child: const Text('CLOSE', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 11)),
690          ),
691      ],
692    );
693  }
694}
